question: The Family Courts (Amendment) Bill seeks to extend the application of the Family Courts Act to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh and Nagaland**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Family Courts (Amendment) Bill **was introduced in **Lok Sabha on July 18, 2022. **
 
• **The Bill amends** the **Family Courts Act, 1984. **
 
• **The Act allows state governments** to **establish Family Courts. **
 
• **The central government** is **empowered to notify dates for the Act to come into force in different states. **
 
• **The governments of Himachal Pradesh and Nagaland **have set up **Family Courts in their states under the Act. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Application of Act in Himachal Pradesh and Nagaland: **
 
• **The Bill** seeks to **extend the application of the Act to the state of Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• The establishment of Family Courts in both the states will be retrospectively valid from these dates.
 
• All actions taken under the Act in both the states,
 
• It included the **appointment of judges, and orders and judgments passed by the Family Courts.**
 
• It will also be **deemed to be valid from these dates** retrospectively.
